verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question for a database with a managed cloud service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes API versioning, version pinning or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, and the SQL API, CLI and MCP server evidence says nothing about versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
